name: io.github.wobuliangren/pet-import-guide
description: Verified pet import rules: 204 routes, 31 airline policies, two official sources per rule.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List all verified pet import routes (from/to country, pet, last-verified date, page URL).

tools.name: get_route
tools.description:
Get the full verified rule record for one route.

Slugs are lowercase country slugs as used on petimportguide.com (e.g. from_slug='united-states', to_slug='japan'); pet is 'dog', 'cat', 'ferret' or 'bird'. The record includes the checklist, timeline, costs, official sources and the date the rules were last verified.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: List all verified airline pet policies in the library.

tools.name: get_airline
tools.description: Get one airline's verified pet policy (e.g. 'klm-pet-policy').

tools.name: rule_changes
tools.description: Latest tracked pet import rule changes, checked against official sources daily.

tools.name: signals
tools.description: Latest official signals (announcements that may change pet import rules).
